# The Digital Wellness Lab

> A research-driven nonprofit institution at Boston Children's Hospital advancing positive digital media experiences and mental health outcomes for youth through evidence-based research, clinical services, and family education.

The Digital Wellness Lab conducts rigorous research on teen digital wellness, interactive media, and internet disorders while translating findings into practical resources for families, educators, and policymakers. The organization combines clinical expertise, youth leadership, and community partnerships to address the intersection of digital technology and adolescent wellbeing.

## Key Topics

- Digital Wellness
- Teen Mental Health
- Youth & Interactive Media
- The 5 M's of Digital Wellness
- Social-Emotional Learning
- Screen Time Management
- Family Digital Literacy
- Artificial Intelligence
- LGBTQ+ Youth Safety
- Internet Disorders
- Research-Based Interventions
- Youth Leadership
- Digital Citizenship
- Content Moderation

## Core Research & Mission

- [Home](https://digitalwellnesslab.org): Homepage for nonprofit research institution promoting positive digital media experiences for youth
- [About Us](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/about): Organizational overview of Digital Wellness Lab's mission and leadership at Boston Children's Hospital
- [Our Research](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/research): Overview of Digital Wellness Lab's research on interactive media and youth development
- [Future Research](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/research/future-research): Future research priorities including youth media use and parenting in digital age

## Research & Publications

- [Pulse Surveys](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/pulse-surveys): Pulse Surveys on teen digital wellness, AI perceptions, and school phone policies
- [Research Briefs](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/research-briefs): Research briefs on content moderation, social-emotional learning, and LGBTQ+ youth safety
- [Long-Form Research](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/research/ongoing-studies): Long-form research studies including HAPPY B2.0 and Digital Media Use Screener
- [Reports](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/reports): Research reports on teen digital wellness, AI recommendations, and industry guidelines
- [Publications Archive](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/publications): Archive of publications, research briefs, and pulse surveys on digital wellness

## Family Resources & Education

- [Family Digital Wellness Guide](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/family-digital-wellness-guide): Comprehensive family guide using 5 M's framework for healthy digital habits
- [Family Guides](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/family-guides): Family guides on parenting advice, digital citizenship, and cyberbullying prevention
- [Recursos en Español](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/recursos-en-espanol): Spanish-language resources on digital wellness and family guides

## Youth Leadership & Community Programs

- [Student Advisory Council](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/student-advisory-council): Student Advisory Council amplifying youth leadership and research collaboration
- [Amplify Youth](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/amplify-youth): Amplify Youth initiative bridging research with real-world digital wellness education

## Clinical Services

- [Clinic for Interactive Media and Internet Disorders (CIMAID)](https://digitalwellnesslab.org/cimaid): CIMAID clinical services for internet disorders and interactive media research
